_comment: Proposed by the SupperMeeting_Carousel route agent (2026-10-15) for the orchestrator; not in migration/parity-exemptions.json. Each entry is a capture or timing artifact; foundation differences (CR-HouseholdDetails-1, CR-SupperMeeting_Details-1) and the per-slide household counts (CR-SupperMeeting_Carousel-1) are left reported on purpose.

rules.reason: Same artifact as CAPTURE-MASKED-IMAGE-SUPPERMEETING on the carousel slides: the subdivision photo and the household photos were masked by the capture (data-masked-src="user-image", src removed; TST rendered 390x260 and 195x130), so the replayed reference shows broken images (390x26, 195x24) while the clone shows the mock placeholder. auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15

Follows from CAPTURE-MASKED-IMAGE-SMCAROUSEL on slide 1 only (11 households in capture and mock): the gallery rows are sized by the masked 24 px broken images (rows 178 px) while the clone shows the 130 px placeholder (rows 193 px). Slides 2 and 3 are left reported until CR-SupperMeeting_Carousel-1 gives them their captured counts. auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15

The CarouselTag text was masked by the capture ('• • •' for '1 / 3'), so the right-aligned tag placeholder of the reference is a third of a pixel wider than the clone's (left 337.688px → 337.344px). auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15

rules.reason: Off-screen slides 2 and 3 were snapshotted while SupperMeeting_DetailsBlock still showed GetSkeleton_UI_SubdivisionDetails (ubt-skeleton-section, 'Subdivision Name Example', counts 10) although their household lists had loaded; the clone shows the loaded card. Limited to the card and actions sections b2-b7 of slides 2-3 (actions menu b8 and household list b9 stay reported). auto-accepted in the user's auto mode 2026-10-15
Timing artifact: the html popup-disable-scroll class at capture time depends on the order of OutSystems model flushes (client-variable flush vs local-storage query flush), not on the screen.
rules.evidence: usePopupWidget re-applies disableScroll on every client-variable change as every OS controller does (OutSystems.js:530153 fireInitialize subscribes clientVariablesHandler; :527146 generation++ + scheduleFlush). TST's final html class then depends on whether an EntityDetailsActions model flush (local IDB queries, OnReady) lands after the last client-variable flush; in the mock app local entities resolve in microtasks. TST itself is inconsistent across routes/states: states.json htmlClass default ''/loading 'popup-disable-scroll' on OneSchoolGlobalDetails, but default 'popup-disable-scroll'/loading '' on SupperMeeting_Carousel. See migration/screens/SupperMeeting_Carousel/analysis/states.json and parity/<state>.json.
